title: Risk factor assessment of prediabetes and diabetes based on epidemic characteristics in new urban areas: a retrospective and a machine learning study
summary: In a retrospective cohort of 47,608 adults from Chongqing medical examinations, the authors combine epidemiologic analysis with ML risk estimation; diabetes prevalence was 5.0±0.6%, prediabetes 5.3±2.0%, and an ML classifier achieved precision 0.76, recall 0.86, F1 0.81. This is a specific local epidemiology/risk result, with single-region retrospective limits.
